name: PacVenture
storyline:
PacVenture is not just a game, it's a quest unlike any other.
The beautiful Ms. Pac has been kidnapped by the Ghost King and taken to his far away castle.
It's up to you to travel through seven mind blowing highly detailed Graphic & Sound 3D Worlds to save your love.
Journey to a City where Ghosts in fancy cars will try to run you down, on beaches where you will have to swim for your life,
and even Nightmare stages and much more. Think you got what it takes to save the beautiful MS. Pac?
